# dsh-ai-jobs

**AI hiring radar for DeepSeek Harness.**
Index the public job boards of AI labs and AI-heavy compan

ies, rank every posting against your own
criteria, mine what they actually ask for (years, skills, d

egree, work mode, comp, visa), and push a
daily digest of the openings worth reading.

No API keys, no accounts, no scraping of logged-in sites — every source is a public ATS board
endpoi
nt that the company itself publishes for its careers page.
## Why

Job hunting for AI roles is a search problem over ~70 companies that each use a different ATS.
The d

ata is public but scattered, re-read by hand every week, and impossible to compare across
companies.
This plugin keeps one local index, so you can ask cross-company questions:

- Which labs are hiring research engineers right now, and what do they require?
- What share of core

AI roles ask for a PhD? What is the median "N+ years"?
- Which openings appeared in the last 7 days

, and which of them match my stack?
- What do Anthropic/OpenAI/Mistral ask for that I do not have ye

and which of them match my stack?
- What do Anthropic/OpenAI/Mistral ask for that I do not have yet?
## What it does
| Step | Detail |
| **Collect** | 71 pre-verified boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever) + Workable/SmartRecruiters for you

r own additions |
| **Normalize** | One posting shape across ATSes: title, locations, remote flag, d

epartment, dates, URL, JD text |
| **Classify** | `core` / `adjacent` / `other` AI relevance, role f

amily, seniority — rule-based and auditable |
| **Mine** | Years of experience, degree, work mode, c

ompensation range, visa sponsorship, 38-skill vocabulary |
| **Rank** | 0–100 score from relevance,

freshness, seniority, your skills of interest and preferred locations |
| **Store** | Local JSON ind

ex with JD snapshots, change history, and a digest cursor |
| **Push** | Markdown digest + optional
daily reminder through the harness scheduler |

## Tools
| Tool | What it returns |
| `ai_jobs_refresh` | Re-index all/A-selected boards. Reports per-board ok/error, added/changed/clos

ed counts. |
| `ai_jobs_search` | Filtered, scored postings: `query`, `company`, `tier`, `seniority`

, `remote`, `location`, `minScore`, `postedWithinDays`, `limit`, `sort`. |
| `ai_jobs_get` | One pos

ting in full: metadata, score, extracted requirements, JD head, stored JD path. |
| `ai_jobs_digest`

| Markdown digest of what changed since the last digest (or the last N days). |
| `ai_jobs_requirem
ents` | Cross-company aggregate: skill frequency, median years, degree mix, work-mode mix, comp rang

es. |
| `ai_jobs_watchlist` | `list` / `add` / `remove` boards (any of greenhouse, ashby, lever, wor

kable, smartrecruiters). |
| `ai_jobs_status` | Index health: boards, open/closed counts, tier mix,

last refresh, last digest, storage path. |
| `ai_jobs_schedule` | `create` / `list` / `delete` the d
aily digest reminder (needs the `schedule` service). |
## Daily digest
Two ways:

1. `ai_jobs_schedule { "action": "create", "time": "09:00:00", "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai" }` —
one

reminder per session, matching `title` ≤ 120 chars.
2. `dailyDigest.enabled: true` in config — the p

lugin arms the reminder itself the first time a
session runs `ai_jobs_refresh` or `ai_jobs_digest`.
The digest only reports postings that are new since the previous digest cursor, so a daily push does
not repeat yesterday's openings. `ai_jobs_digest { "days": 7 }` ignores the cursor.
## Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/ai-jobs` (falls back to `~/.dsh/ai-jobs`) | Index, JD snapshots, digest sta

te |
| `lang` | `zh` | Digest language (`zh` / `en`) |
| `concurrency` | `4` | Parallel board fetche

s |
| `timeoutMs` | `25000` | Per-request timeout |
| `jdMaxChars` | `20000` | JD text kept per post

ing |
| `maxDetailPerBoard` | `60` | Greenhouse JD fetches per board per refresh |
| `tags` | from s

eed | `frontier-lab`, `ai-native`, `ai-user` — used by scoring and filters |
| `companies` | `[]` |
Extra boards appended to the shipped seed |
## Data sources
All endpoints are public and unauthenticated:
| ATS | Endpoint | Seed boards |

| Greenhouse | `boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs` | 33 |
| Ashby | `api.ashbyhq.com/p

osting-api/job-board/{token}` | 37 |
| Lever | `api.lever.co/v0/postings/{token}?mode=json` | 1 |
|

Workable | `apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{token}` | — |
| SmartRecruiters | `api.smartr
ecruiters.com/v1/companies/{token}/postings` | — |

The shipped seed covers Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Mistral, Cohere, Perplexity, Thinking Machines,
Curs

or, Cognition, Harvey, Sierra, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Suno, Midjourney, Runway, Baseten, Cerebras,
Fir

eworks, Modal, Anyscale, Together, Scale, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex,
Databri

cks, Snowflake, Stripe, Cloudflare, Datadog, Elastic, MongoDB, Figma, Notion, Vercel, Plaid,
Ramp, A

irbnb, Instacart, Lyft, Pinterest, Reddit, Discord, Roblox, Duolingo, Khan Academy, Spotify
and more

. Companies on Greenhouse store their JD behind a second request; the plugin fetches it only
for new
or changed postings.

`ai_jobs_watchlist` adds any other company whose careers page exposes one of these boards. Token
dis
covery is manual by design — the seed was verified one board at a time.

## Data & privacy

- Everything is stored locally under `$DSH_HOME/ai-jobs`: `store.json` (index), `jd/*.txt` (JD
snaps

hots), digest cursor.
- The plugin sends no telemetry and has no backend. It only calls the public b

oard endpoints listed
above, with a descriptive User-Agent.
- Nothing is scraped from logged-in site

s; no credentials are read or stored.
- Deleting `dataDir` removes everything.
